title: WITH faith I draw nigh my Lord

lines.text: WITH faith I draw nigh my Lord
and my God
To the Fountain of our life
I beseechThee Lord he army humble cry
Make me star of all Thy works.
Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord
To the Cherub, Seraphim
Draw me nearer; nearer blessed Lord
To the precious riven side.
The Twelve Thousand of the clan of Levites
Have the seal and grace of God
Be merciful Lord unto me Thy child
Seal me with the blood of Christ.
The Twelve Thousand of the clan of Juda
Have the seal and grace of God
Be merciful Lord unto meThy child
Seal me with the blood of Christ.
The Twelve Thousand of the clan of Joseph
Have the seal and grace of God
Be merciful Lord unto me Thy child
Seal me with the blood of Christ.
Word of Jehovah Never never fail
Word of God will surely pass
Jehovah’s promise will surely fulfil
Like to Jacob Isaac's Son.
Never and never Child of God suffer
In this world or that to come
Dusk or dawn may we never ever starve
In Cherubim Seraphim.
